name: Org — CRUD de Necesidades y visibilidad en Panorama

planSteps.description: Fill out 'Nombre' with 'TestSprite QA Org 3', 'Correo electrónico' with a random email ending in '@testsprite.test', and 'Contraseña' with 'Test1234!', then submit the form.
Click on the 'Soy una fundación' card
Fill out the organization onboarding form: Name 'TestSprite QA -- ignorar 3', Phone '3001234567', City 'Bogotá'. Submit the form.
Click the button to add a new need. Fill description '[TEST] no es una necesidad real', category 'alimentos', quantity '50', unit 'unidades', urgency 'media', and save.
Verify '[TEST] no es una necesidad real' appears in the needs list
Select the 'Necesidades' tab if it's not already active
Verify '[TEST] no es una necesidad real' appears in the public panorama list
Click the delete button for '[TEST] no es una necesidad real' and confirm the deletion.
Verify '[TEST] no es una necesidad real' no longer appears in the needs list
